#[arg(long)]\n147\t        until: Option<String>,\n148\t\n149\t        /// Show cooldown state for idle-time strands (reflect, weave, pulse, unravel).\n150\t        #[arg(long)]\n151\t #[arg(short = 'o', long)]\n267\t        output: Option<PathBuf>,\n268\t    },\n269\t\n270\t    /// Show outcome statistics aggregated from telemetry logs.\n271\t    ///\n272\t    /// Reads JSONL #[arg(long)]\n286\t        since: Option<String>,\n287\t\n288\t        /// Include only events until this time (e.g., 1h, 24h, 7d, 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z).\n289\t        #[arg(long)]\n290\t        until: Option<String>,\n291\t\n292\t        /// Output format.\n293\t        #[arg(long, value_enum, default_value = \"table\")]\n294\t        format: ListFormat,\n295\t    },\n296\t\n297\t    /// Run long)]\n301\t        workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n302\t    },\n303\t}\n304\t\n305\t/// Output format for the list command.\n306\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\n307\tpub enum ListFormat {\n308\t    Table,\n309\t    Json,\n310\t}\n311\t\n312\t/// Output format for the logs command.\n313\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]\n314\tpub enum LogFormat {\n315\t    /// Human-readable table format #[value(name = \"task_type\")]\n333\t    TaskType,\n334\t    /// Group by worker identifier (e.g., `\"needle-alpha\"`).\n335\t    #[value(name = \"worker\")]\n336\t    Worker,\n337\t}\n338\t\n339\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n340\t// Entry point\n341\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n342\t\n343\t/// Entry point called from `main`.\n344\tpub fn run() -> Result<()> {\n345\t    let cli = Cli::parse();\n346\t\n347\t    match cli.command {\n348\t        CliCommand::Run {\n349\t            workspace,\n350\t            agent,\n351\t            count,\n352\t            identifier,\n353\t            timeout,\n354\t            resume,\n355\t            hot_reload,\n356\t        } => cmd_run(\n357\t            workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, resume, hot_reload,\n358\t        ),\n359\t        CliCommand::Stop { all, identifier } => cmd_stop(all, identifier),\n360\t        CliCommand::Cleanup { all, identifier } => cmd_cleanup(all, identifier),\n361\t        CliCommand::List { format } => cmd_list(format),\n362\t        CliCommand::Attach { identifier } => cmd_attach(&identifier),\n363\t        CliCommand::Status {\n364\t            format,\n365\t            by_worker,\n366\t            cost,\n367\t            since,\n368\t            until,\n369\t            idle_strands,\n370\t        } => cmd_status(format, by_worker, cost, since, until, idle_strands),\n371\t        CliCommand::Logs {\n372\t            follow,\n373\t            filter,\n374\t            since,\n375\t            until,\n376\t            format,\n377\t        } => cmd_logs(follow, filter, since, until, format),\n378\t        CliCommand::ConfigCmd {\n379\t            get,\n380\t            dump,\n381\t            show_source,\n382\t        } => cmd_config(get, dump, show_source),\n383\t        CliCommand::Doctor { repair, workspace } => cmd_doctor(repair, workspace),\n384\t        CliCommand::Init => cmd_init(),\n385\t        CliCommand::Version => {\n386\t            cmd_version();\n387\t            Ok(())\n388\t        }\n389\t        CliCommand::TestAgent { name } => cmd_test_agent(&name),\n390\t        CliCommand::Canary { status } => cmd_canary(status),\n391\t        CliCommand::Upgrade { check } => cmd_upgrade(check),\n392\t        CliCommand::Rollback => cmd_rollback(),\n393\t        CliCommand::Reflect { workspace, force } => cmd_reflect(workspace, force),\n394\t        CliCommand::UpdateRules { output } => cmd_update_rules(output),\n395\t        CliCommand::Stats {\n396\t            by,\n397\t            since,\n398\t            until,\n399\t            format,\n400\t        } => cmd_stats(by, since, until, format),\n401\t        CliCommand::Supervise { workspace } => cmd_supervise(workspace),\n402\t    }\n403\t}\n404\t\n405\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n406\t// Command handlers\n407\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n408\t\n409\t/// `needle run` — launch a worker.\n410\t///\n411\t/// Always creates dedicated tmux sessions for workers, even when invoked from\n412\t/// inside an existing tmux session. The only exception is a re-entrant inner\n413\t/// invocation launched by `launch_in_tmux()`, which is identified by the\n414\t/// `NEEDLE_INNER=1` environment variable and runs the worker directly.\n415\tfn cmd_run(\n416\t    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n417\t    agent: Option<String>,\n418\t    count: u32,\n419\t    identifier: Option<String>,\n420\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n421\t    resume: bool,\n422\t    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n423\t) -> Result<()> {\n424\t    // Determine workspace root (CLI arg → canonicalized, else global default).\n425\t    let workspace_root = if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n426\t        ws.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| ws.clone())\n427\t    } else {\n428\t        let global = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n429\t        global.workspace.default.clone()\n430\t    };\n431\t\n432\t    // Load full resolved config (global → workspace .needle.yaml → env → CLI).\n433\t    let cli_overrides = CliOverrides {\n434\t        workspace: Some(workspace_root.clone()),\n435\t        agent_binary: agent.clone(),\n436\t        max_workers: None,\n437\t        ..Default::default()\n438\t    };\n439\t    let (mut config, _) = ConfigLoader::load_resolved(&workspace_root, cli_overrides)?;\n440\t\n441\t    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n442\t        config.agent.timeout = t;\n443\t    }\n444\t\n445\t    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n446\t        config.self_modification.hot_reload = hr;\n447\t    }\n448\t\n449\t    if resume {\n450\t        // Hot-reload resume: inherit worker identity from --identifier,\n451\t        // load state from heartbeat file + registry, continue from SELECTING.\n452\t        let worker_id = identifier\n453\t            .clone()\n454\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n455\t\n456\t        // Load resume state from heartbeat and registry.\n457\t        let resume_state = crate::upgrade::ResumeState::load(&config, &worker_id)?;\n458\t\n459\t        // Emit upgrade.completed telemetry.\n460\t        let current_hash = crate::upgrade::file_hash(\n461\t            &std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?,\n462\t        )\n463\t        .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n464\t\n465\t        match &resume_state {\n466\t            Some(state) => {\n467\t                tracing::info!(\n468\t                    worker = %worker_id,\n469\t                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n470\t                    beads_processed = state.beads_processed,\n471\t                    session = %state.session,\n472\t                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload\"\n473\t                );\n474\t            }\n475\t            None => {\n476\t                tracing::info!(\n477\t                    worker = %worker_id,\n478\t                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n479\t                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload (no prior state found)\"\n480\t                );\n481\t            }\n482\t        }\n483\t\n484\t        let tel = crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(worker_id.clone(), &config.telemetry)\n485\t            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n486\t                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n487\t                crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(worker_id.clone())\n488\t            });\n489\t        tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::UpgradeCompleted {\n490\t            new_hash: current_hash,\n491\t        })?;\n492\t\n493\t        return run_worker(config, worker_id);\n494\t    }\n495\t\n496\t    if is_needle_inner() {\n497\t        // Re-entrant inner invocation launched by launch_in_tmux() — run\n498\t        // the worker directly inside the dedicated session already created.\n499\t        let worker_id = identifier\n500\t            .clone()\n501\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n502\t        let agent_name = agent.as_deref().unwrap_or(&config.agent.default);\n503\t        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n504\t        tracing::info!(worker = %worker_id, session = %session_name, \"starting worker (inner re-entrant invocation)\");\n505\t        run_worker(config, worker_id)\n506\t    } else {\n507\t        // Always create dedicated tmux sessions, even if already inside tmux.\n508\t        launch_workers(\n509\t            config, workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, hot_reload,\n510\t        )\n511\t    }\n512\t}\n513\t\n514\t/// Launch `count` workers in separate tmux sessions with staggered startup delays.\n515\tpub fn launch_workers(\n516\t    config: Config,\n517\t    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n518\t    agent: Option<String>,\n519\t    count: u32,\n520\t    identifier: Option<String>,\n521\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n522\t    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n523\t) -> Result<()> {\n524\t    let agent_name = agent\n525\t        .as_deref()\n526\t        .unwrap_or(&config.agent.default)\n527\t        .to_string();\n528\t    let stagger_secs = config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds;\n529\t    let max_workers = config.worker.max_workers;\n530\t\n531\t    if count == 0 {\n532\t        bail!(\"--count must be at least 1\");\n533\t    }\n534\t    if count as usize > NATO_ALPHABET.len() {\n535\t        bail!(\n536\t            \"--count {} exceeds the maximum of {} (NATO alphabet size)\",\n537\t            count,\n538\t            NATO_ALPHABET.len()\n539\t        );\n540\t    }\n541\t\n542\t    // Enforce max_workers cap (0 means unlimited).\n543\t    let effective_count = if max_workers > 0 && count > max_workers {\n544\t        tracing::warn!(\n545\t            requested = count,\n546\t            capped_to = max_workers,\n547\t            \"count exceeds max_workers; capping\"\n548\t        );\n549\t        eprintln!(\n550\t            \"Warning: --count {count} exceeds max_workers={max_workers}; launching {max_workers} workers\"\n551\t        );\n552\t        max_workers\n553\t    } else {\n554\t        count\n555\t    };\n556\t\n557\t    // --identifier is only meaningful for a single worker.\n558\t    if effective_count > 1 && identifier.is_some() {\n559\t        bail!(\"--identifier cannot be combined with --count > 1; identifiers are auto-assigned from the NATO alphabet\");\n560\t    }\n561\t\n562\t    // Detect existing sessions to avoid name collisions.\n563\t    let occupied = occupied_worker_ids(&agent_name)?;\n564\t    if !occupied.is_empty() {\n565\t        tracing::info!(\n566\t            occupied = ?occupied,\n567\t            \"found existing worker sessions\"\n568\t        );\n569\t    }\n570\t\n571\t    // Reject --identifier collision early.\n572\t    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n573\t        if occupied.contains(id) {\n574\t            bail!(\n575\t                \"worker '{}' is already running in session 'needle-{}-{}'\",\n576\t                id,\n577\t                agent_name,\n578\t                id\n579\t            );\n580\t        }\n581\t    }\n582\t\n583\t    // Build the list of worker IDs, skipping occupied names.\n584\t    let worker_ids: Vec<String> = if effective_count == 1 {\n585\t        vec![identifier.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n586\t            // Pick the first available NATO name.\n587\t            NATO_ALPHABET\n588\t                .iter()\n589\t                .find(|name| !occupied.contains(**name))\n590\t                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n591\t                .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string())\n592\t        })]\n593\t    } else {\n594\t        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(effective_count as usize);\n595\t        for name in NATO_ALPHABET {\n596\t            if ids.len() >= effective_count as usize {\n597\t                break;\n598\t            }\n599\t            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n600\t                tracing::warn!(\n601\t                    worker_id = %name,\n602\t                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n603\t                );\n604\t                continue;\n605\t            }\n606\t            ids.push(name.to_string());\n607\t        }\n608\t        if ids.len() < effective_count as usize {\n609\t            bail!(\n610\t                \"cannot launch {} workers — only {} NATO names available ({} occupied)\",\n611\t                effective_count,\n612\t                ids.len(),\n613\t                occupied.len()\n614\t            );\n615\t        }\n616\t        ids\n617\t    };\n618\t\n619\t    for (seq, worker_id) in worker_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n620\t        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n621\t\n622\t        tracing::info!(\n623\t            worker_id = %worker_id,\n624\t            sequence = seq,\n625\t            total = effective_count,\n626\t            session = %session_name,\n627\t            \"launching worker\"\n628\t        );\n629\t\n630\t        // Stagger: sleep before launching subsequent workers.\n631\t        if seq > 0 && stagger_secs > 0 {\n632\t            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(stagger_secs));\n633\t        }\n634\t\n635\t        launch_in_tmux(\n636\t            &session_name,\n637\t            workspace.clone(),\n638\t            agent.clone(),\n639\t            Some(worker_id.clone()),\n640\t            timeout,\n641\t            hot_reload,\n642\t        )?;\n643\t\n644\t        println!(\n645\t            \"[{}/{}] Started worker '{}' in tmux session: {session_name}\",\n646\t            seq + 1,\n647\t            effective_count,\n648\t            worker_id\n649\t        );\n650\t    }\n651\t\n652\t    let sanitized_agent = sanitize_session_name(&agent_name);\n653\t    if effective_count > 1 {\n654\t        println!(\n655\t            \"\\nStarted {effective_count} workers (stagger: {stagger_secs}s between launches).\"\n656\t        );\n657\t        println!(\"Attach to a worker with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-<name>\");\n658\t    } else {\n659\t        let worker_id = &worker_ids[0];\n660\t        println!(\"Attach with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-{worker_id}\");\n661\t    }\n662\t\n663\t    Ok(())\n664\t}\n665\t\n666\t/// Initialize the tracing subscriber with OTLP layer if configured.\n667\t///\n668\t/// This must be called before any tracing spans are created so that the OTLP\n669\t/// layer can export them to the configured collector.\n670\t///\n671\t/// Note: Shutdown is handled by the OtlpSink in the telemetry module, not here.\n672\t#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\n673\tfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n674\t    worker_id: String,\n675\t    session_id: String,\n676\t    config: &crate::config::Config,\n677\t) -> Result<()> {\n678\t    use opentelemetry::trace::TracerProvider;\n679\t    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n680\t\n681\t    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n682\t\n683\t    // Check if OTLP is enabled\n684\t    if !config.telemetry.otlp_sink.enabled {\n685\t        // No OTLP - just initialize with fmt layer\n686\t        let fmt_layer = tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n687\t            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n688\t            .with_ansi(use_ansi);\n689\t        tracing_subscriber::registry()\n690\t            .with(fmt_layer)\n691\t            .try_init()\n692\t            .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n693\t        return Ok(());\n694\t    }\n695\t\n696\t    // OTLP is enabled - create the OTLP layer inline\n697\t    // We create it inline to avoid type erasure issues with boxed layers\n698\t    let otlp_config = &config.telemetry.otlp_sink;\n699\t\n700\t    // Build resource attributes\n701\t    let resource = crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_resource(\n702\t        &worker_id,\n703\t        &session_id,\n704\t        otlp_config,\n705\t        Some(&config.agent.default),\n706\t        None, // model - not available in AgentConfig\n707\t        config.workspace.default.to_str(),\n708\t    )\n709\t    .context(\"failed to build OTel resource\")?;\n710\t\n711\t    // Create drop channel for tracing layer\n712\t    let (drop_tx, mut drop_rx) =\n713\t        tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<crate::telemetry::otlp::DropEvent>();\n714\t    tokio::spawn(async move {\n715\t        while let Some(drop) = drop_rx.recv().await {\n716\t            tracing::warn!(\n717\t                signal = drop.signal.as_str(),\n718\t                dropped_count = drop.dropped_count,\n719\t                \"OTLP tracing layer export failure\"\n720\t            );\n721\t        }\n722\t    });\n723\t\n724\t    // Build exporters and tracer provider based on protocol\n725\t    let (tracer_provider, ..) = match otlp_config.protocol.as_str() {\n726\t        \"grpc\" => {\n727\t            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_grpc_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n728\t        }\n729\t        \"http\" | \"http/protobuf\" => {\n730\t            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_http_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n731\t        }\n732\t        other => anyhow::bail!(\"invalid OTLP protocol: {other}, must be 'grpc' or 'http'\"),\n733\t    };\n734\t\n735\t    // Create the OpenTelemetry tracing layer\n736\t    let otlp_layer = cmd_run(\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    count: u32,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    resume: bool,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Determine workspace root (CLI arg → canonicalized, else global default).\n    let workspace_root = if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n        ws.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| ws.clone())\n    } else {\n        let global = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n        global.workspace.default.clone()\n    };\n\n    // Load full resolved config t;\n    }\n\n    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n        config.self_modification.hot_reload = hr;\n    }\n\n    if resume {\n        // Hot-reload resume: inherit worker identity from --identifier,\n .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n\n        match &resume_state {\n            Some(state) => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    worker = %worker_id,\n \"resuming worker after hot-reload\"\n                );\n            }\n            None => {\n                tracing::info!(\n                    worker = %worker_id,\n                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload (no prior state found)\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        let tel = crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(worker_id.clone(), &config.telemetry)\n            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, stagger_secs = config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds;\n    let max_workers = config.worker.max_workers;\n\n    if count == 0 {\n        bail!(\"--count must be at least 1\");\n    }\n    if count as usize > NATO_ALPHABET.len() {\n        bail!(\n            \"--count {} exceeds the maximum of {} (NATO alphabet size)\",\n            count,\n            NATO_ALPHABET.len()\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Enforce max_workers cap (0 means unlimited).\n    let effective_count = if max_workers > 0 && count > max_workers {\n        tracing::warn!(\n            requested = count,\n            capped_to = max_workers,\n            \"count exceeds max_workers; capping\"\n        );\n        eprintln!(\n            \"Warning: --count {count} exceeds max_workers={max_workers}; launching {max_workers} workers\"\n        );\n        max_workers\n    } else {\n        count\n    };\n\n    // --identifier is only meaningful for a single worker.\n    if effective_count > 1 && identifier.is_some() {\n        bail!(\"--identifier cannot be combined with --count > 1; identifiers are auto-assigned from the NATO alphabet\");\n    }\n\n    // Detect existing sessions to avoid name collisions.\n    let occupied = occupied_worker_ids(&agent_name)?;\n    if !occupied.is_empty() {\n        tracing::info!(\n            occupied = ?occupied,\n            \"found existing worker sessions\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Reject --identifier collision early.\n    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n        if occupied.contains(id) {\n            bail!(\n                \"worker '{}' is already running in session 'needle-{}-{}'\",\n                id,\n                agent_name,\n                id\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Build the list of worker IDs, skipping occupied names.\n    let worker_ids: Vec<String> = if effective_count == 1 {\n        vec![identifier.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n            // Pick the first available NATO name.\n            NATO_ALPHABET\n                .iter()\n                .find(|name| !occupied.contains(**name))\n                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string())\n        })]\n    } else {\n        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(effective_count as usize);\n        for name in NATO_ALPHABET {\n            if ids.len() >= effective_count as usize {\n                break;\n            }\n            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    worker_id = %name,\n                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n                );\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids.push(name.to_string());\n        }\n        if ids.len() < effective_count as usize {\n            bail!(\n                \"cannot launch {} workers — only {} NATO names available ({} occupied)\",\n                effective_count,\n                ids.len(),\n                occupied.len()\n            );\n        }\n        ids\n    };\n\n    for (seq, worker_id) in worker_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            worker_id = %worker_id,\n            sequence = seq,\n            total = effective_count,\n            session = %session_name,\n            \"launching worker\"\n        );\n\n        // Stagger: sleep before launching subsequent workers.\n        if seq > 0 && stagger_secs > 0 {\n            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(stagger_secs));\n        }\n\n        launch_in_tmux(\n            &session_name,\n            workspace.clone(),\n            agent.clone(),\n            Some(worker_id.clone()),\n            timeout,\n            hot_reload,\n        )?;\n\n        println!(\n            \"[{}/{}] Started worker '{}' in tmux session: {session_name}\",\n            seq + 1,\n            effective_count,\n            worker_id\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sanitized_agent = sanitize_session_name(&agent_name);\n    if effective_count > 1 {\n        println!(\n            \"\\nStarted {effective_count} workers (stagger: {stagger_secs}s between launches).\"\n        );\n        println!(\"Attach to a worker with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-<name>\");\n    } else {\n        let worker_id = &worker_ids[0];\n        println!(\"Attach with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-{worker_id}\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Initialize the tracing subscriber with OTLP layer if configured.\n///\n/// This must be called before any tracing spans are created so that the OTLP\n/// layer can export them to the configured collector.\n///\n/// Note: Shutdown is handled by the OtlpSink in the telemetry module, not here.\n#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\nfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n    worker_id: String,\n    session_id: String,\n    config: &crate::config::Config,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use opentelemetry::trace::TracerProvider;\n    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\n    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n\n    // Check if OTLP is enabled\n    if !config.telemetry.otlp_sink.enabled {\n        // No OTLP - just initialize with fmt layer\n        let fmt_layer = tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n            .with_ansi(use_ansi);\n        tracing_subscriber::registry()\n            .with(fmt_layer)\n            .try_init()\n            .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // OTLP is enabled - create the OTLP layer inline\n    // We create it inline to avoid type erasure issues with boxed layers\n    let otlp_config = &config.telemetry.otlp_sink;\n\n    // Build resource attributes\n    let resource = crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_resource(\n        &worker_id,\n        &session_id,\n        otlp_config,\n        Some(&config.agent.default),\n        None, // model - not available in AgentConfig\n        config.workspace.default.to_str(),\n    )\n    .context(\"failed to build OTel resource\")?;\n\n    // Create drop channel for tracing layer\n    let (drop_tx, mut drop_rx) =\n        tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<crate::telemetry::otlp::DropEvent>();\n    tokio::spawn(async move {\n        while let Some(drop) = drop_rx.recv().await {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                signal = drop.signal.as_str(),\n                dropped_count = drop.dropped_count,\n                \"OTLP tracing layer export failure\"\n            );\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Build exporters and tracer provider based on protocol\n    let (tracer_provider, ..) = match otlp_config.protocol.as_str() {\n        \"grpc\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_grpc_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        \"http\" | \"http/protobuf\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_http_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        other => anyhow::bail!(\"invalid OTLP protocol: {other}, must be 'grpc' or 'http'\"),\n    };\n\n    // Create the OpenTelemetry tracing layer\n    let otlp_layer = tracing_opentelemetry::layer().with_tracer(tracer_provider.tracer(\"needle\"));\n\n    // Create a fmt layer that works with any subscriber implementing LookupSpan\n    // We build this after the OTLP layer to ensure proper type compatibility\n    let subscriber = tracing_subscriber::registry().with(otlp_layer).with(\n        tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n            .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n    );\n\n    subscriber\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber with OTLP\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// No-op tracing initialization when OTLP feature is disabled.\n#[cfg(not(feature = \"otlp\"))]\nfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n    _worker_id: String,\n    _session_id: String,\n    _config: &crate::config::Config,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\n    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n\n    // Initialize with just the .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n        )\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Helper function to determine ANSI support (non-Android platforms).\n#[cfg(not(target_os = \"android\"))]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    atty::is(atty::Stream::Stderr)\n}\n\n/// Helper function for Android (no ANSI).\n#[cfg(target_os = \"android\")]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    false\n}\n\n/// Generate a session ID for a worker.\n///\n/// Uses the telemetry module's session ID generator.\nfn generate_session_id_for_worker() -> String {\n    crate::telemetry::generate_session_id()\n}\n\n/// Start the worker state machine (called when inside tmux or for direct mode).\n///\n/// Creates telemetry and the tokio runtime *before* any other initialization\n/// so that `worker.booting` is the very first JSONL event. Each subsequent\n/// init step is wrapped with `init.step.started` / `init.step.completed` so a\n/// silent hang pinpoints the exact blocking call.\nfn run_worker(config: Config, worker_name: String) -> Result<()> {\n    let boot_start = Instant::now();\n    let qualified_id = format!(\"{}-{}\", config.agent.default, worker_name);\n\n    // Phase 0: create tokio runtime + telemetry, emit worker.booting immediately.\n    // Emit eprintln diagnostics before each step so hangs are visible even if telemetry fails.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating tokio runtime...\");\n    let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().context(\"failed to create tokio runtime\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tokio runtime created\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: initializing tracing subscriber...\");\n    let session_id = generate_session_id_for_worker();\n    init_tracing_subscriber(qualified_id.clone(), session_id.clone(), &config)?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tracing subscriber initialized\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating telemetry...\");\n    let telemetry =\n        Telemetry::from_config(qualified_id.clone(), &config.telemetry).unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to create hook-enabled telemetry, falling back\");\n            Telemetry::new(qualified_id.clone())\n        });\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: telemetry created\");\n\n    // Emit worker.booting SYNCHRONOUSLY before starting the async writer.\n    // This guarantees the event is written to disk even if start_and_wait() hangs.\n    // Fixes the silent pre-init deadlock where the JSONL file is created but empty.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: emitting worker.booting event (sync)...\");\n    telemetry.emit_sync(EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n        worker_name: worker_name.clone(),\n        version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string(),\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: worker.booting written to disk\");\n\n    // Start the async writer thread after worker.booting is on disk.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting telemetry writer thread...\");\n    rt.block_on(telemetry.start_and_wait())\n        .context(\"writer thread failed to start\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: writer thread started\");\n\n    // Phase 1: bead store discovery.\n    // Use BfCliBeadStore for atomic server-selected bead claiming.\n    let store: Arc<dyn crate::bead_store::BeadStore> =\n        Arc::new(init_step(\"bead_store_discover\", &telemetry, || {\n            crate::bead_store::BfCliBeadStore::discover(\n                config.workspace.default.clone(),\n                None,                       // model: do not filter by model — beads are untagged\n                Some(\"needle\".to_string()), // harness\n                Some(env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string()), // harness_version\n            )\n            .context(\"failed to locate bf CLI for bead store\")\n        })?);\n\n    // Phase 2: worker construction (heavy — prompt loading, adapter discovery, etc.).\n    let mut worker = init_step(\"worker_construction\", &telemetry, || {\n        Ok(Worker::new_with_telemetry(\n            config,\n            worker_name.clone(),\n            store,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        ))\n    })?;\n\n    // Boot timeout guard: self-abort if init took >60 s.\n    let elapsed_ms = boot_start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    if elapsed_ms > 60_000 {\n        telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerBootTimeout { elapsed_ms })?;\n        bail!(\"boot exceeded 60 s ({elapsed_ms} ms), aborting\");\n    }\n\n    eprintln!(\n        \"NEEDLE worker boot: all init steps completed in {elapsed_ms}ms, starting worker loop...\"\n    );\n    let result = rt.block_on(worker.run())?;\n\n    tracing::info!(final_state = %result, \"worker finished\");\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Emit start/complete telemetry around a fallible initialization step.\n///\n/// Each step's completion is force-flushed to disk so that if a subsequent\n/// step blocks indefinitely, the telemetry log shows exactly where it stopped.\n/// Also emits eprintln diagnostics for visibility even if telemetry hangs.\nfn init_step<T, F>(name: &str, tel: &Telemetry, f: F) -> Result<T>\nwhere\n    F: FnOnce() -> Result<T>,\n{\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting init step '{name}'...\");\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepStarted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n    })?;\n    let t = Instant::now();\n    let result = f();\n    let elapsed = t.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepCompleted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n        duration_ms: elapsed,\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: init step '{name}' completed in {elapsed}ms\");\n    // Force-flush so the step completion is visible before the next (potentially blocking) step.\n    tel.force_flush(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1))?;\n    result\n}\n\n/// Returns true when this process is a re-entrant inner invocation launched\n/// by `launch_in_tmux()`, indicated by `NEEDLE_INNER=1` in the environment.\nfn is_needle_inner() -> bool {\n    std::env::var(\"NEEDLE_INNER\").is_ok_and(|v| v == \"1\")\n}\n\n/// Create a single tmux session and re-exec self inside it with `--count 1`.\nfn launch_in_tmux(\n    session_name: &str,\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Build the command that tmux will run inside the session.\n    let self_exe = std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?;\n    let mut inner_args = vec![\"run\".to_string()];\n\n    if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n        inner_args.push(\"--workspace\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(ws.display().to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(ref a) = agent {\n        inner_args.push(\"--agent\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(a.clone());\n    }\n    // Each session runs exactly one worker; identifier is always resolved before call.\n    inner_args.push(\"--count\".to_string());\n    inner_args.push(\"1\".to_string());\n    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n        inner_args.push(\"--identifier\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(id.clone());\n    }\n    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n        inner_args.push(\"--timeout\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(t.to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n        inner_args.push(\"--hot-reload\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(hr.to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Build stderr log path: ~/.needle/logs/<session_name>.stderr.log\n    let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \".\".to_string());\n    let stderr_log = format!(\"{home}/.needle/logs/{session_name}.stderr.log\");\n\n    let inner_cmd = format!(\n        \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 {} {} 2>> {}\",\n        shell_escape(&self_exe.display().to_string()),\n        inner_args\n            .iter()\n            .map(|a| shell_escape(a))\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\" \"),\n        shell_escape(&stderr_log)\n    );\n\n    let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\"new-session\", \"-d\", \"-s\", session_name, &inner_cmd])\n        .status()\n        .context(\"failed to launch tmux — is tmux installed?\")?;\n\n    if !status.success() {\n        bail!(\n            \"tmux new-session exited with status {} for session '{}'\",\n            status,\n            session_name\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle stop` — send SIGTERM to worker processes in tmux sessions.\nfn cmd_stop(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    if !all && identifier.is_none() {\n        bail!(\"specify --all or --identifier <NAME>\");\n    }\n\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    for session in &targets {\n        tracing::info!(session = %session, \"sending SIGTERM to tmux session\");\n        // tmux send-keys sends C-c to the foreground process\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"send-keys\", \"-t\", session, \"C-c\", \"\"])\n            .status()\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to send SIGTERM to session '{session}'\"))?;\n\n        if status.success() {\n            // Wait up to 5 seconds for the worker to exit gracefully\n            for _ in 0..50 {\n                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));\n                let session_exists = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                    .args([\"has-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                    .output()\n                    .map(|o| o.status.success())\n                    .unwrap_or(false);\n                if !session_exists {\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            // Kill the session to clean up (worker may have already exited)\n            let kill_status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                .status();\n            match kill_status {\n                Ok(s) if s.success() => println!(\"Stopped: {session}\"),\n                Ok(_) => println!(\"Stopped: {session} (session already gone)\"),\n                Err(e) => println!(\"Warning: stopped {session} but failed to kill session: {e}\"),\n            }\n        } else {\n            println!(\"Warning: could not stop session '{session}' (status: {status})\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle cleanup` — remove orphaned tmux sessions.\n///\n/// Finds and removes needle tmux sessions that no longer have active workers.\n/// With --all, removes all needle sessions regardless of worker status.\nfn cmd_cleanup(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| id.is_empty() || s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let mut cleaned = 0;\n    for session in &targets {\n        // Kill the session\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n            .status();\n\n        match status {\n            Ok(s) if s.success() => {\n                println!(\"Cleaned up: {session}\");\n                cleaned += 1;\n            }\n            Ok(_) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: session '{session}' already gone\");\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: failed to cleanup session '{session}': {e}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if cleaned == 0 {\n        println!(\"No sessions cleaned up.\");\n    } else {\n        println!(\"Cleaned up {cleaned} session(s).\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle list` — show running needle sessions.\nfn cmd_list(format: ListFormat) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        match format {\n            ListFormat::Table => println!(\"No needle sessions running.\"),\n            ListFormat::Json => println!(\"[]\"),\n        }\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    match format {\n        ListFormat::Table => {\n            println!(\"{:<40} {:<20} {:<10}\", \"SESSION\", \"CREATED\", \"STATUS\");\n            println!(\"{}\", \"-\".repeat(70));\n            for s in &sessions {\n                println!(\"{:<40} {:<20} {:<10}\", s.name, s.created, s.status);\n            }\n        }\n        ListFormat::Json => {\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&sessions)\n                .context(\"failed to serialize sessions to JSON\")?;\n            println!(\"{json}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle init` — initialize v2 config with optional v1 migration.\n///\n/// Creates ~/.config/needle/config.yaml. Detects existing v1 artifacts\n/// in ~/.needle/ and migrates compatible settings (agent name, workspace\n/// path, worker count) to the v2 YAML schema. Safe to run on already-\n/// initialized installs (idempotent).\nfn cmd_init() -> Result<()> {\n    /// Resolve a path relative to the user's home directory.\n    fn dirs_or_home(relative: &str) -> PathBuf {\n        if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os(\"HOME\") {\n            PathBuf::from(home).join(relative)\n        } else {\n            PathBuf::from(\"/tmp\").join(relative)\n        }\n    }\n\n    let config_path = dirs_or_home(\".config/needle/config.yaml\");\n    let v1_dir = dirs_or_home(\".needle\");\n\n    // Check if v2 config already exists.\n    if config_path.exists() {\n        println!(\"Config already exists: {}\", config_path.display());\n        let config = ConfigLoader::load_from_path(&config_path)?;\n        println!(\"  Agent default: {}\", config.agent.default);\n        println!(\"  Workspace: {}\", config.workspace.default.display());\n        println!(\"  Max workers: {}\", config.worker.max_workers);\n        println!(\"\\nTo reinitialize, delete the existing config file first.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Detect v1 artifacts and migrate compatible settings.\n    let mut agent_name = None::<String>;\n    let mut workspace_path = None::<PathBuf>;\n\n    // Check for v1 directory.\n    if v1_dir.exists() && v1_dir.is_dir() {\n        println!(\"Detected v1 artifacts: {}\", v1_dir.display());\n\n        // Look for v1 config hints (file-based heuristics).\n        // v1 stored agent name as a subdirectory: ~/.needle/<agent>/\n        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&v1_dir) {\n            for entry in entries.flatten() {\n                let path = entry.path();\n                if path.is_dir() {\n                    let name = path.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str());\n                    // Skip common non-agent subdirectories.\n                    if let Some(name) = name {\n                        if !matches!(name, \"state\" | \"logs\" | \"canary\" | \"config\") {\n                            agent_name = Some(name.to_string());\n                            println!(\"  Migrating agent name from v1: {}\", name);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // v1 workspace hints: look for recent .beads directories under $HOME.\n        let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \".\".to_string());\n        let home_path = PathBuf::from(&home);\n        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&home_path) {\n            for entry in entries.flatten() {\n                let path = entry.path();\n                if path.is_dir() && path.join(\".beads\").exists() {\n                    // Prefer the most recently modified workspace.\n                    let modified = entry\n                        .metadata()\n                        .and_then(|m| m.modified())\n                        .unwrap_or(std::time::SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH);\n                    let current_best = workspace_path\n                        .as_ref()\n                        .and_then(|p| std::fs::metadata(p).ok()?.modified().ok())\n                        .unwrap_or(std::time::SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH);\n                    if modified > current_best {\n                        workspace_path = Some(path.clone());\n                        println!(\"  Migrating workspace path from v1: {}\", path.display());\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Build the config with migrated values or defaults.\n    let default_config = Config::default();\n    let agent_default = agent_name.unwrap_or_else(|| default_config.agent.default.clone());\n    let workspace_default =\n        workspace_path.unwrap_or_else(|| default_config.workspace.default.clone());\n\n    // Construct a minimal config YAML with comments explaining each field.\n    let config_yaml = format!(\n        r#\"# NEEDLE v2 Configuration\n# Migrated from v1: {v1_status}\n#\n# This file controls NEEDLE's global behavior. cmd_test_agent(name: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let result = dispatch::test_agent(name, &config)?;\n    dispatch::print_test_result(&result);\n\n    if ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `needle attach <identifier>` — attach to a running worker's tmux session.\nfn cmd_attach(identifier: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        bail!(\"no needle sessions running\");\n    }\n\n    // Find matching session: exact match on identifier portion or substring match on full name.\n    let matches: Vec<&TmuxSession> = sessions\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|s| s.name.ends_with(&format!(\"-{identifier}\")) || s.name.contains(identifier))\n        .collect();\n\n    if matches.is_empty() {\n        let available: Vec<&str> = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect();\n        bail!(\n            \"no session matching '{}'; available: {}\",\n            identifier,\n            available.join(\", \")\n        );\n    }\n\n    if matches.len() > 1 {\n        let names: Vec<&str> = matches.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect();\n        bail!(\n            \"ambiguous identifier '{}'; matches: {}\",\n            identifier,\n            names.join(\", \")\n        );\n    }\n\n    let session = &matches[0].name;\n    let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\"attach-session\", \"-t\", session])\n        .status()\n        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to attach to tmux session '{session}'\"))?;\n\n    if !status.success() {\n        bail!(\"tmux attach-session exited with status {status} for '{session}'\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle status` — show fleet status summary.\nfn cmd_status(\n    format: ListFormat,\n    by_worker: bool,\n    cost: bool,\n    since: Option<String>,\n    until: Option<String>,\n    idle_strands: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let needle_home = config.workspace.home.clone();\n    let registry = stats` — show outcome statistics from telemetry logs.\nfn cmd_stats(\n    by: StatsBy,\n    since: Option<String>,\n    until: Option<String>,\n    format: ListFormat,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use crate::stats::{compute_stats, StatsDimension};\n\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let log_dir = config.workspace.home.join(\"logs\");\n\n    let since_dt = since.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_since).transpose()?;\n    let until_dt = until.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_until).transpose()?;\n    let events = telemetry::read_logs(&log_dir, since_dt, until_dt, None)?;\n\n    let dimension = match by {\n        StatsBy::TemplateVersion => StatsDimension::TemplateVersion,\n        StatsBy::TaskType => StatsDimension::TaskType,\n        StatsBy::Worker => StatsDimension::Worker,\n    };\n\n    let mut rows = compute_stats(&events, dimension);\n    // Sort by beads descending so most active groups appear first.\n    rows.sort_by(|a, b| b.beads.cmp(&a.beads).then(a.key.cmp(&b.key)));\n\n    let dim_label = match by {\n        StatsBy::TemplateVersion => \"TEMPLATE VERSION\",\n        StatsBy::TaskType => \"TASK TYPE\",\n        StatsBy::Worker => \"WORKER\",\n    };\n\n    match format {\n        ListFormat::Table => {\n            if rows.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"No telemetry data found.\");\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n            let key_width = rows.iter().map(|r| r.key.len()).max().unwrap_or(16).max(16);\n            println!(\n                \"{:<width$} {:>6} {:>6} {:>6} {:>8} {:>9} {:>10} {:>12}\",\n                dim_label,\n                \"BEADS\",\n                \"PASS\",\n                \"FAIL\",\n                \"TIMEOUT\",\n                \"PASS RATE\",\n                \"AVG TOK\",\n                \"AVG COST\",\n                width = key_width,\n            );\n            println!(\n                \"{}\",\n                \"-\".repeat(key_width + 6 + 6 + 6 + 8 + 9 + 10 + 12 + 7)\n            );\n            for row in &rows {\n                let pass_rate = row\n                    .pass_rate()\n                    .map(|r| format!(\"{:.1}%\", r * 100.0))\n                    .unwrap_or_else(|| \"-\".to_string());\n                let avg_tok = row\n                    .avg_tokens()\n                    .map(|t| format!(\"{:.0}\", t))\n                    .unwrap_or_else(|| \"-\".to_string());\n                let avg_cost = row\n                    .avg_cost_usd()\n                    .map(|c| format!(\"${:.5}\", c))\n
